The Honourable Dr. B. R. Ambedkar has on the forenoon of the 11th October 1951 vacated the office of Minister of the Council of the President.

The Honourable Shri Rafi Ahmed Kidwai has, on the afternoon of the 2nd August, 1951, vacated the office of Minister of the Council of the President.
